description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Twin Element Mode (Fire, Holy)], [Damage Cap +10000], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Basch], [Apex Flame Purge Damage Tracker] and [Apex Flame Purge Level] to the user

description.name: Twin Element Mode (Fire, Holy)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire]/[Attach Holy] after using a Fire/Holy ability

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Basch
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Flame Purge (0~2), removed after using Apex Flame Purge two times

description.name: Apex Flame Purge Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Flame Purge level by 1 after dealing 100001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Basch]

description.name: Apex Flame Purge Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Flame Purge level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Basch]
